“We Buy Sneakers” ad templates

Graphics Studio makes buyback ads for sneaker resellers and consignment shops who buy new and worn sneakers. Pick a design, type your phone number and area, and download an image ready for Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Instagram or a printed flyer.

Sneakers designs are on the way. Until they are in the studio, you can make a sneakers ad today from a design in the studio with your own photo.

Browse the designs Pricing

How it works

  1. Pick a design. Open the gallery and click one. A design without a product picture in front works best.
  2. Make it yours. Upload your own photo of the sneakers as the background (iPhone HEIC photos work), then type your headline, your phone number and your ZIP or city.
  3. Download and post. Choose a size (square for feeds, 9:16 for stories, 8.5×11 for print) and download. Every Phones & Devices design, and the top 3 of every other category, is on the free plan.

What to put on a sneakers buyback ad

  • What you take: new in the box, worn, rare pairs, and the sizes you buy.
  • Whether you need the box and receipt, and whether you check pairs in person.
  • How you pay and where you meet.
  • Your phone number and your area.

Keep it to one headline, a few short selling points and one number. People scroll past an ad in a second; the ones that get texts are readable at a glance on a phone.

Questions

When are the sneaker designs coming?

They are being made now, and this page will link to them once they are in the studio. Until then you can make a sneaker ad from a design in the studio with your own photo.

Can I put brand logos on my ad?

Only use pictures you have the right to use. Naming the brands you buy tells sellers what you take; a logo you did not make is not yours to put on an ad.

Is it free?

You can design without an account. Downloading needs a free account: 3 downloads a week at 1080 pixels with a BUYBACK.AD watermark. Pro is $15 a month for 100 downloads a month up to 2160 pixels, no watermark, every design.
